title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Users can now launch Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread, understand context, create PRs in GitHub, and provide updates directly in Slack conversations.

title: Cursor 1.0: BugBot, Background Agent Access to Everyone, One-Click MCP Install
description: Cursor 1.0 launches with BugBot for automatic code review, Background Agent expanded to all users, Agent support in Jupyter Notebooks, Memories feature beta, MCP one-click install with OAuth support, richer chat responses with visualizations, and new Dashboard with usage analytics.

title: Source Code Leak Incident
description: Anthropic accidentally shipped the entire Claude Code source code to the public npm registry on March 31, 2026, revealing potential prompt injection vulnerabilities and sparking security discussions.

community_feedback.quote: The biggest story was 'The Great Claude Code Leak of 2026' where Anthropic accidentally shipped the entire source code of Claude Code to the public npm registry

title: Week 14: Computer Use comes to CLI in Research Preview
description: Claude can now open native apps, click through UI, and verify changes directly from the terminal. Also includes /powerup interactive lessons, flicker-free alt-screen rendering, per-tool MCP result-size override up to 500K, and plugin executables on Bash tool's PATH.

community_feedback.quote: I would venture to guess that the author tried to come up with some new angles on the news of the Claude Code leak, because it's a hot topic
User complaints about degraded performance - A GitHub issue documenting Claude Code's problems reached #2 on Hacker News with 734 points, with developers criticizing Anthropic
Long-term users shared experiences after months of daily use, discussing debugging challenges and patterns they've encountered

title: Simplified Pricing and Max Mode for All Models
description: Introduced unified request-based pricing, Max Mode now available for all state-of-the-art models with token-based pricing, new Tab model trained for multi-file edits and refactors, and @folders support for including entire codebase in context.
